picks.headline: Samsung's answer to Meta's Ray-Bans is (almost) here, with a little help from Google
picks.excerpt: At Unpacked, Samsung previewed two Gemini-powered smart glasses built with Google, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster: non-display frames with cameras that let Gemini see and analyze your surroundings for live translation, navigation and notification summaries. Heavy workloads run on the paired Galaxy phone, a clear design bet on glasses-as-companion AI form factor for creatives and everyday users.
picks.rationale: The only genuinely-new gadgets story in the pool after dedup: Samsung's first mainstream Gemini AI eyewear, with fashion partners (Gentle Monster, Warby Parker) and a see-and-analyze design bet that concretely reshapes ambient capture for creatives -- never previously published as its own card.
